sections.title: About Me
sections.markdown:
Dr. R. Kottaimalai is a dedicated academician, researcher, and innovator with over 15 years of professional experience spanning teaching, research, and industry. He specializes in the interdisciplinary domains of artificial intelligence, medical image processing, and biomedical instrumentation, with a strong focus on developing technology-driven solutions for healthcare applications.

He holds a Ph.D. in Instrumentation and Control Engineering, with research centered on multimodal brain image analysis using soft computing techniques for clinical and therapeutic applications. His academic excellence is reflected in his achievement as a Gold Medalist in M.Tech, demonstrating a strong foundation in engineering and analytical problem-solving.

Dr. R. Kottaimalai has made notable research contributions through numerous publications in high-impact SCI and Scopus-indexed journals, with an established research profile indicated by a strong citation record. His work primarily focuses on applying machine learning and deep learning techniques for early disease detection, including neurological disorders, osteoporosis, and other medical conditions.

He has successfully secured and contributed to multiple funded research projects, particularly in the areas of non-invasive diagnostic systems, smart healthcare devices, and emerging technologies. In addition, he actively serves as a reviewer for reputed international journals, contributing to the advancement of global research standards.

With extensive teaching experience, he is known for his effective teaching methodology and student mentoring, consistently achieving excellent academic outcomes. He has guided several undergraduate and postgraduate projects and is actively supervising research scholars in cutting-edge areas.

Beyond academics, Dr. R. Kottaimalai contributes significantly to institutional development, accreditation processes, and academic administration, demonstrating strong leadership and organizational capabilities.

Driven by a passion for innovation and societal impact, he continues to work towards integrating advanced engineering solutions with real-world healthcare challenges, aiming to bridge the gap between research and practical implementation.

sections.title: Research Centre (lab At Irc)
sections.markdown:
Centre for Biomedical Research and Diagnostic Techniques Development

About the Centre:
The Centre for Biomedical Research and Diagnostic Techniques Development is established with the vision of advancing innovative healthcare technologies through interdisciplinary research and development. The centre focuses on designing and developing cost-effective, non-invasive diagnostic solutions to address critical challenges in modern healthcare.
The centre aims to bridge the gap between engineering and medical sciences by integrating advanced methodologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Medical Image Processing, and Biomedical Instrumentation. It actively promotes translational research that can be applied in real-world clinical environments for early diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment support.

Objectives:
•	To develop innovative diagnostic systems for early disease detection 
•	To promote AI-driven healthcare solutions 
•	To design low-cost biomedical devices for societal impact 
•	To encourage interdisciplinary collaboration between engineers, clinicians, and researchers 
•	To support student research, innovation, and entrepreneurship in healthcare technologies 

Key Focus Areas:
•	Medical Image Processing and Analysis 
•	AI and Machine Learning in Healthcare 
•	Bone Health and Osteoporosis Detection 
•	Neurological Disorder Analysis (Brain Imaging) 
•	Biomedical Signal Processing (ECG, EEG) 
•	IoT-based Healthcare Systems 
•	Non-invasive Diagnostic Device Development 

Facilities & Expertise:
The centre is equipped with tools and platforms supporting:
•	Simulation and modeling (MATLAB, LabVIEW) 
•	Medical data analysis and AI frameworks 
•	Biomedical instrumentation setups 
•	Sensor-based system development 
The centre also benefits from strong expertise in:
•	Clinical image analysis 
•	Algorithm development 
•	Embedded system design for healthcare 

Research & Contributions:
The centre actively contributes through:
•	High-quality publications in SCI and Scopus-indexed journals 
•	Funded research projects from government and innovation agencies 
•	Development of prototypes and patented technologies 
•	Collaboration with healthcare professionals for clinical validation 

Vision:
To become a centre of excellence in biomedical research and diagnostic innovation, delivering impactful solutions for improving healthcare accessibility and quality.

Mission:
•	To foster research-driven innovation in healthcare technologies 
•	To develop affordable and accessible diagnostic solutions 
•	To nurture skilled researchers and innovators in biomedical engineering 
•	To contribute to societal well-being through technology
